description: Returns the signed-in person's Famlore record: their curiosities (id, raw_text, review_status, interest_label; review_status 'pending' means no topic is named yet), their open quest attempts with each quest's title, objective, steps and evidence requirement, recent memory including style notes, the latest stored connection, explicit preferences, and recentEvidence (submitted work with no style note yet, artifacts attached). A quest with room_id was written by a room member. content_truncated marks shortened quest text. Read-only; takes no arguments.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: get_profile_context
title: Read Your Famlore Record
